title: Across the Island
description: A mother and son carry a solar panel across India's Ghoramara Island, preparing to install it at their home in this image from the 2026 Giga Photo Award competition. The remote island in the Sundarbans—an enormous mangrove forest that protects the India-Bangladesh coast—lacks a conventional electricity grid. After Super Cyclone Yaas hit the region in 2021, flooding and high tides cut off power to the island. Since then, solar panels have become common in order for families to keep phones charged and lights on during emergencies.
translated_description: 一位母亲和儿子抬着一块太阳能板，穿过印度的戈拉马拉岛，准备安装在他们家中——这张照片来自2026年吉加摄影奖大赛。这座偏远的岛屿位于孙德尔本斯——一片保护印度-孟加拉国海岸的巨大红树林——缺乏传统的电网。2021年超级气旋“亚斯”袭击该地区后，洪水和涨潮切断了岛上的电力供应。自那时起，太阳能板变得普遍，以便家庭在紧急情况下保持手机充电和照明。
